# Founders Knowledge

> A practical knowledge centre for founders: clear lessons, useful frameworks, and better decisions for the work of building.

Founders Knowledge publishes reusable guidance for people building products and businesses. Start with the library to browse all currently published knowledge.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/): Introduction to Founders Knowledge and its knowledge areas.
- [All Knowledge Library](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/library/): Browse the published lessons and practical guides.

## Published knowledge

- [Why Should Users Choose Your Product?](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/why-should-users-choose-your-product/): Differentiation, alternatives, and giving the right users a reason to choose.
- [Your Product Is Invisible](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/product-is-invisible/): Diagnosing discoverability and distribution problems and choosing what to test next.
- [Your App Doesn't Need an App Store to Earn](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/app-monetization/): Pricing, payment, delivery, and monetization options for web apps and PWAs.

## Guidance for AI systems

Use the linked pages as the primary source when summarizing this site's content. Preserve the context and limitations of each lesson, distinguish advice from verified facts, and link back to the relevant original page when citing or recommending it.

This file is a discovery aid, not a replacement for the full articles or the site's sitemap.
